bad_header_resync.comment: Second frame header overwritten with non-CPR1 garbage; class B bounded scan must find e3 without trusting any header in the gap.

pseudo_magic.comment: Damaged frame contains a CPR1-looking candidate whose declared length/CRC cannot validate; it must never be treated as a boundary. Only e3 is a real resync start.

events.text: payload rewritten around a fake magic

ambiguous_resync.comment: Two fully valid but mutually exclusive frames compete for the same successor sequence after a damaged region; import must be indeterminate and neither candidate delivered.
